title: Keep each conversion's saved form responses
changes: Open saved stage checkpoints and per-form responses directly from each output.
Keep original form and source labels when you update or rename project files.
Check an existing run's status without replaying conversion or import.
limitations: Experimental preview with bounded Forms-to-native-APEX conversion coverage.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
